results.title: UPDATE: Bandits invaded Dirin Daji in Sakaba LGA, Kebbi State, after Isha prayer tonight, abducting three women, including the wife of Alhaj
results.description:
UPDATE: Bandits invaded Dirin Daji in Sakaba LGA, Kebbi State, after Isha prayer tonight, abducting three women, including the wife of Alhaji Aminu Mai Suga, popularly known as AA Suga, the ADC chairman in the LGA.

Two other women were shot during the attack. One was shot in the stomach and the other in the buttock. Both are receiving treatment at General Hospital, according to local sources.

Security personnel reportedly attempted to rescue the abducted women but were unsuccessful.

Normalcy is gradually returning to the town, although residents remain shaken by the attack. The whereabouts of the three abducted women remain a major concern.

results.title: UPDATE: Reports from Mada, Gusau LGA of Zamfara State, suggest that more than 40 bandits have been killed in the ongoing clash between rival
results.description:
UPDATE: Reports from Mada, Gusau LGA of Zamfara State, suggest that more than 40 bandits have been killed in the ongoing clash between rival groups. Those reportedly killed include Kachallah Dogo Baldu and Sanata, the younger brother of Ado Aleru.

This development could bring some relief to residents who have suffered years of bandit attacks, kidnappings and cattle rustling. For the people of Zamfara, this is a welcome development, and everyone hopes it will translate into lasting peace and safety for their communities.
